answer: Because the timing is published against the ember challenge, the wander audit can replay the nectar history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 69 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4584 identities would post 745 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
